reply: Thank you for explaining that you paid a $15,000.00 deposit for a new home and have not received a formal loan decision, which you need to use your financing contingency. We understand the financial strain. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage team. Please ask each lender in writing for the status of your application and, if declined, a written notice of the decision. Keep copies of your contract and messages. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your servicer stopped paying your property taxes and insurance while still collecting escrow, and that the escrow refund check has not arrived. We understand your frustration and the penalties this caused. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please send the tax bill with a written notice of error, and ask for tracking details for the refund check. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after a job loss you were told you must be two months behind before you can be considered for forbearance. We understand your concern about falling behind on purpose. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loss mitigation team. Please send a written request for a review of your hardship and the options available, and keep a record of your calls. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your $2,100.00 escrow refund check after the loan payoff has not arrived and that you cannot reach anyone now that the loan is closed. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please send a written request for the check details and tracking information to the servicer's designated address, and keep proof of delivery. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your concern about how much of your mortgage payment goes to interest rather than principal. We understand why you want this reviewed. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please ask in writing for an amortization schedule and your payment history, so you can see how each payment was split between principal, interest and taxes. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you want proof that a $1,700.00 property tax payment was actually made from your escrow. We understand you want documentation, not just a ledger entry. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please send a written request for information asking for proof of the tax payment, and check the county's payment records for that year. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that changing to biweekly payments has taken over two months because forms can only be mailed or faxed and your submissions go missing. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please keep copies and fax confirmations of every form you sent, and ask in writing for confirmation once the change is made. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your servicer will not discuss your loan modification because its records still show active litigation, even though you sent a dismissal form. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loss mitigation team. Please send the servicer a copy of the dismissal form in writing, and ask what else is needed before it can speak with you directly. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were charged late fees for automatic drafts your bank says were never attempted, and that your request to stop the drafts was refused. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please send a written notice of error with your bank's records, and keep confirmation of the payment you made by phone. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you received a notice of intent to foreclose even though you have not missed a payment in five years, and that accounting has not replied. We understand how alarming this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please send a written notice of error with your payment records to the servicer's designated address, and keep proof of delivery. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that over $2,500.00 in late fees have built up and that your balance seems high after nearly 20 years of payments. We understand your concern on a fixed budget. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Late fees can only be charged as your loan documents allow, so please ask in writing for your full payment history and fee breakdown. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after paying off your mortgage you have not received the documents needed to release the lien, and that the same note was sent twice. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please send a written request for the lien release or satisfaction document and the missing endorsements, and keep copies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your principal-only payments of $36.00 are being returned even though you send them to the address you were given. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please send a written request asking where and how principal-only payments should be sent, and keep copies of the returned checks. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your escrow shortage payment was not credited and that you were charged a late fee after the bill was raised. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please send a written notice of error with proof of the shortage check and your on-time payments, and keep copies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

We are sorry for the loss of your mother. Thank you for explaining that you have been paying on her home equity line, which you believe was not valid. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the home equity team. Please ask in writing for the account records, including the agreement and payment history, and keep copies of your payments. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you pay half your payment every two weeks yet are charged late fees and must call each month to reverse them. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please ask in writing how partial payments are applied and whether a biweekly schedule can be set up, and keep your payment records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that only $3,000.00 of the $24,000.00 in insurance funds has been released, even though the storm repairs are complete. We understand your concern about paying your contractor. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loss draft team. Please send the completion documents and inspection results in writing, and ask for a list of anything still needed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after your loan transferred, only part of your payment and escrow prepaid amounts were sent to the new servicer. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please send both servicers a written notice of error with your closing documents, cashier's check and statements, and ask for a reconciliation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that one payment was returned and two others have no record on your account. We understand how worrying this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please send a written notice of error with proof of each payment, such as bank statements or confirmation numbers, and keep copies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your payments are not shown on your statements and that you received an arrears and foreclosure letter despite sending proof of payment. We understand how alarming this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please send a written notice of error with copies of your payments, and ask for your complete transaction history. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your escrow statement said your payment would rise by $15.00, but you are being asked to pay much more. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please send a written notice of error with the escrow statement and your letters, and ask for a corrected payment calculation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were reported 30 days late during your forbearance and loan transfer, and that you later received a default letter. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loss mitigation team. Please keep the forbearance agreement and the email confirming your workout plan, and dispute the reporting with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that payments made during and after your forbearance have been rejected and returned. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please send a written request asking how and where payments should be made, and keep records of each returned payment. Making your payments on time remains important. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you sent a loan modification application and received no response. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loss mitigation team. Please keep a copy of your application and proof of when it was sent, and send a written request for its status. You can ask for a review if an application is denied. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that after a loan modification you believe you were scammed. We understand how upsetting this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loss mitigation team. Please keep the modification documents and any payment records, and contact your servicer only through the number on your statement. Be wary of anyone asking for upfront fees. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after paying off your loan, you were sent a payoff quote that you believe overcharges you by about $120.00. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. A payoff amount includes interest through the payoff date, so please ask in writing for an itemized payoff statement. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your loan was transferred without notice, then placed in pre-foreclosure, and that your payment plan is far above your normal payment. We are sorry for the stress this has caused while you are on leave. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loss mitigation team. Please ask in writing for the options available to you based on your income. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $24.00 monthly service fee has been charged to your account for years, totaling about $490.00, and that you have not been able to get the records. We understand your concern on a fixed income. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please ask in writing for the fee terms and the account history showing when the fee began. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your payment was raised after your loan was transferred, that two payments were taken, and that you now owe more to escrow. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please send a written notice of error with your bank statements showing both payments, and ask for an escrow analysis. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you caught up on your missed payments as agreed, but were then locked out and sent to foreclosure over fees you do not understand. We understand how alarming this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loss mitigation team. Please ask in writing for an itemized list of the fees, and keep proof of your catch-up payments. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
